{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Strategic

|descr= Set fade value of CfgORBAT group and all groups below it.

|s1= [path, alpha, time] call [[BIS_fnc_ORBATSetGroupFade]]

|p1= path: [[Config]] - path to group in CfgORBAT. If only this parameter is passed, visibility settings for the group are removed.
|p2= alpha: [[Number]] - alpha (0 = transparent, 1 = full color)
|p3= time: [[time]] - commit time in seconds

|r1= [[Boolean]]

|x1= <sqf>[configFile >> "CfgORBAT" >> "BIS" >> "O_Brigade", 0.5, 5] call BIS_fnc_ORBATSetGroupFade;</sqf>
